skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions or mixed numbers with common denominators without requiring borrowing or simplification.

skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Identifying a common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing / Regrouping
skills.definition: Regrouping a whole number or mixed number to subtract a larger fractional part from a smaller one.

skills.name: Handling Whole Numbers
skills.definition: Subtracting a fraction or mixed number from a whole number, or vice versa.

skills.name: Simplifying Improper Fractions
skills.definition: Converting or working with improper fractions embedded within mixed numbers (e.g., 2 3/2 or 1 5/3).
